children.value: > Fact From Story: Because video platforms artificially limit our perspective, we miss the cues we’re used to from live, in-person interactions.
> > Fact From Story: As social beings, we’re highly attuned to these cues, and it takes more work for us to look for and process them in the virtual environment, leading to the fatigue we experience.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: It takes more work for us to look for and process cues in a virtual environment than in person.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Missing cues from live, in-person interactions can cause difficulty.
